issues.failure_explanation: Corollary cor:Elman gives m ≳ (1/δ) log(12/ε) with sin δ = dist/‖C‖. From Corollary cor:1, dist ≥ C_3 Λ^{-1} p_f^{-2} and ‖B^{-1}A‖ ≤ C_2 Λ, so 1/δ ≤ 1/sin δ ≤ C_2 Λ^2 p_f^2 / C_3. The stated bound has Λ (not Λ^2) and omits C_2, so it does not follow from the cited estimates.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace Λ by Λ^2 (and include C_2 or absorb it into the constant) in eq:it_bound and in Corollary cor:3.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit iteration counts in Corollaries cor:2 and cor:3 are misstated in their dependence on Λ; the k- and p_f-dependence (the advertised (log k)^2 growth) is unaffected since Λ is treated as bounded.
issues.title: GMRES iteration bound in Corollary cor:2 has wrong power of Lambda (and drops C_2)
issues.why_classification: A one-line correction of the constant/Λ-power restores the result with no loss in the k- or p_f-rates.

issues.failure_explanation: The L^2 interpolation estimate eq:hope3 with rate h/p_f from an H^1 seminorm is not covered by Theorem thm:interpolationMS1 (stated only for m≥2; nodal interpolation of general H^1 functions is not even defined in d≥2). Using the available m=2 estimate together with the inverse estimate eq:inverse gives only ‖(I−I_h)(χv_h)‖_{L^2} ≲ h|χv_h|_{H^1}, so eq:hope1 would read |Π^{L^2}(χv_h)|_{H^1} ≲ p_f^2|χv_h|_{H^1} rather than p_f, i.e. the p_f^2 in eq:split_result becomes p_f^4.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the m=1 application by a p-robust H^1-stable quasi-interpolant with L^2 error ≲ (h/p_f)|w|_{H^1} (e.g. an hp quasi-interpolation result), or accept the weaker p_f^4 splitting constant and (log k)^4 iteration growth.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f-explicit stable splitting, hence the p_f^{-2} lower bound on the field of values in Theorem thm:main and the (log k)^2 GMRES iteration growth in Theorem thm:final1, are not established as written; with the source's own tools only p_f^{-4} / (log k)^4 follows.
issues.title: Lemma lem:split applies Theorem thm:interpolationMS1 with m=1, outside its stated range m≥2, and this step supplies the p_f-linear factor
issues.why_classification: Fixing it requires importing/proving a new p-explicit approximation lemma; otherwise the advertised rate degrades by a factor (log k)^2 but a comparable result survives.

issues.failure_explanation: Since Σ_ℓ ṽ_{h,ℓ} = v_h, one has Σ_ℓ v_{h,ℓ} = v_h − Σ_ℓ I_h(ψ_ℓ ṽ_{h,ℓ}), and the remainder is nonzero in general (ṽ_{h,ℓ} is a global L^2 projection, nonzero outside Ω_ℓ where ψ_ℓ = 1). The proof only bounds ‖v_{h,ℓ} − ṽ_{h,ℓ}‖ and never verifies the claimed identity v_h = Σ v_{h,ℓ}. Lemma lem:key_Garding uses this exact identity in eq:combine1, so an uncontrolled term a(w_h, r_h) is missing there.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate Lemma lem:split as an approximate splitting v_h = Σ v_{h,ℓ} + r_h with ‖r_h‖_{H^1_k} bounded by a (kL)^{-M} multiple of ‖v_h‖ (using the DiStTs decay summed over subdomains, enlarging C_width if needed), and add the extra term C_cont‖w_h‖‖r_h‖ in Lemma lem:key_Garding, absorbing it via the smallness of E.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f-explicit stable splitting and Lemma lem:key_Garding are not proved as stated, so the lower bound eq:lower in Theorem thm:main (hence Theorem thm:final1 and its GMRES corollaries) lacks a complete proof.
issues.title: Lemma lem:split's localised functions v_{h,ℓ} do not sum exactly to v_h
issues.why_classification: A contained new argument (bounding the summed remainder) and restated lemmas are needed, but the conclusions and rates survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Applying Theorem thm:interpolationMS1 (m=2) to u_{H^2} gives an H^1_k error ≲ (kh/p_f)(1+kh/p_f)·k^{-2}|u_{H^2}|_{H^2}; with the bound stated in Theorem thm:LSW3 this carries the factor k^{-1}C_sol (≥ cL, and polynomially large for trapping K), yet eq:etabound_new has no such factor. Either Theorem thm:LSW3 is misstated (the cited GLSW1 decomposition bounds the H^2 component independently of C_sol) or the corollary, and then Corollary cor:MS3/Theorem thm:final1 in the trapping regime, do not follow.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the u_{H^2} bound in Theorem thm:LSW3 to the C_sol-independent form (‖u_{H^2}‖_{H^2_k} ≤ C‖f‖) consistent with the cited source, which then yields eq:etabound_new.
issues.overall_effect: As written, Corollary cor:MS1 does not follow from Theorem thm:LSW3; the statements of the two results are mutually inconsistent.
issues.title: Corollary cor:MS1's first term is inconsistent with the u_{H^2} bound stated in Theorem thm:LSW3
issues.why_classification: The resolution is a corrected transcription of a cited decomposition bound; all downstream conclusions are then preserved.

issues.failure_explanation: The corollary allows arbitrary p_f ≥ 1 + C_degree log k (no upper bound), but the displayed inequality replaces (p_f c)^{p_f}(kL)^{-p_f} by its value at the smallest admissible p_f, which is not a valid upper bound when p_f is large (e.g. p_f ≫ kL, where (c p_f/(kL))^{p_f} is huge). The intended conclusion is true (the ratio (h/L)/(h/L+σ) < 1 uniformly gives exponential smallness), but the argument as written does not prove it.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound ((h/L)/(h/L+σ))^{p_f} ≤ (1 + kL/(c p_f))^{-p_f} = exp(−(kL/c)·log(1+s)/s) with s = kL/(c p_f), which is ≤ C(kL)^{-1} uniformly over all admissible p_f.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the smallness of the second term in eq:etabound_new in Corollary cor:MS3 (and the analogous step invoked in Theorem thm:final1) has a gap for large p_f; the statement itself remains correct.
issues.title: Invalid step bounding (c p_f)^{p_f} via the lower bound on p_f in the proof of Corollary cor:MS3
issues.why_classification: A short elementary replacement estimate closes the gap with no change to any statement.
